description_en: Adds a data source to the development environment or production environment of a workspace
description_zh: 在指定项目空间创建一条数据源，可以是开发环境或生产环境
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-data-source --project-id 2 --name demo_holo_datasource --type hologres --connection-properties-mode UrlMode --description this_is_a_holo_datasource --connection-properties '{"envType":"Prod","regionId":"cn-beijing","instanceId":"hgprecn-cn-x0r3oun4k001","database":"testdb","securityProtocol":"authTypeNone","authType":"Executor","authIdentity":"1107550004253538"}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/overview) and go to the workspace management page to obtain the ID.

This parameter is used to determine the DataWorks workspaces used for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://dataworks.console.aliyun.com/overview)，进入工作空间管理页面获取ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source. The name can be up to 255 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh: 数据源的名称，由字母、数字、下划线组合，且不能以数字和下划线开头，最长255 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the data source. More than 70 types of data sources are supported in DataWorks. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据源的类型，目前已经支持数据源类型 70+，数据源类型枚举说明参考文档：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The mode in which you want to add the data source. The mode varies based on the data source type. Valid values for MySQL data sources:

InstanceMode: instance mode

UrlMode: connection string mode
parameters.help_zh:
数据源添加的类别，不同Type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，以MySQL数据源举例有：
InstanceMode（实例模式）
UrlMode（连接串模式）
parameters.name: connection_properties_mode

parameters.help_en: The description of the data source. The description cannot exceed 3,000 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据源描述信息，长度不超过 3000 个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The connection configurations of the data source, including the connection address, access identity, and environment information. The envType parameter specifies the environment in which the data source is used. Valid values of the envType parameter:

Dev: development environment

Prod: production environment

The parameters that you need to configure for the data source vary based on the mode in which the data source is added. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据源的具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。数据源环境envType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）

不同类型的数据源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2852465.html
parameters.name: connection_properties
